title: Extending the prayer hall and adding two classrooms
story: Our congregation has outgrown the building. On Fridays the second sitting runs into the car park and the weekend classes are held in a portable cabin that fails inspection this year. We have planning permission to extend the hall by nine metres and add two classrooms above it. The build is costed at 340,000 GBP and we have 90,000 GBP pledged. The freehold is held by the trust and will stay with the trust after the work.
reviewerNote: Declined for the zakat badge. Our published policy, which our advisory board ratified, does not extend the fi sabilillah heading to the construction of a building, and the copy is clear that the freehold stays with the trust afterwards. I want the file to be honest about what this decision is: recognised scholars differ on exactly this question and two of the bodies our policy cites have reached opposite conclusions on mosque projects, so this is our policy being applied and not a finding about what is permitted. I said that to the organizer in writing, quoted the policy paragraph, and pointed out that the campaign keeps running for non-zakat giving, which is the larger part of its funding here.
